friction.summary: MPT LoanPay rejects a floored PeriodicPayment (tecINSUFFICIENT_PAYMENT); the payable amount must round UP to a whole base unit, unlike an XRP-drops vault which tolerates the same sub-unit truncation

LoanBrokerSet on an open-ended vault is accepted on hackathon rippled 3.4.0-rc1 but rejected tecNO_PERMISSION on public Devnet 3.4.0-rc5 although Account == Vault.Owner; the code implies an ownership error, not a build or vault-kind policy
A private vault stores its DomainID on the share MPTokenIssuance (vault.shares.DomainID), not at the vault top level; an assertion on Vault.DomainID failed until the field was found under shares

Validated-ledger and submit requests to the Devnet timed out several times mid-flow (guardrail run, an MPT collateralized-origination LoanSet submit, a public-Devnet multi-tx flow), each forcing a full re-run
MPToken balance model: MPTAmount is the spendable balance and LockedAmount is additive (total owned = MPTAmount + LockedAmount); computing spendable as MPTAmount - LockedAmount is wrong

An MPT-asset VaultCreate must OMIT Scale entirely (Scale: 0 fails client-side validation and is not normalized); Asset is { mpt_issuance_id } with no value while deposit/withdraw Amount carries the value
PermissionedDomainSet.AcceptedCredentials requires the wrapped [{ Credential: { Issuer, CredentialType } }] form; the flat { Issuer, CredentialType } is rejected by validation

error_codes.actual_mistake: paid the floor of a fractional MPT PeriodicPayment; the payable amount must round up to a whole base unit
build/vault-kind policy on public Devnet rc5, not an ownership problem; Account equaled Vault.Owner
finish attempted before FinishAfter; generic permission code, not a too-early signal
wrong Fulfillment supplied for the crypto-condition; clear and specific
Fulfillment omitted on a conditioned escrow; rejected at submission with a generic malformed code
cover-ratio invariant breach, not a balance shortfall; CoverAvailable was ample
intended gate: non-member or unaccepted credential on a private vault (negative control)

abandoned.what: top-level Vault.DomainID assumption for a private vault
abandoned.blocked_at: DomainID is on the share MPTokenIssuance (vault.shares.DomainID)

abandoned.what: MPToken spendable computed as MPTAmount - LockedAmount
abandoned.blocked_at: MPTAmount is already the spendable balance and LockedAmount is additive

abandoned.what: EscrowFinish negative control using a missing Fulfillment
abandoned.blocked_at: a missing Fulfillment on a conditioned escrow is temMALFORMED at submission, not a clean tec; switched to a wrong fulfillment

workarounds.what: manual round-up of the loan's high-precision PeriodicPayment/TotalValueOutstanding to a payable whole base unit (roundUpToAssetUnit)
hand-built PREIMAGE-SHA-256 condition and fulfillment for escrow, as xrpl.js bundles no crypto-conditions helper

single_fix: Provide an xrpl.js helper that converts a loan's high-precision accounting fields (PeriodicPayment, TotalValueOutstanding) into the correct payable amount for the vault asset, rounding up to a whole base unit, and document that MPT vaults do not tolerate the sub-unit truncation XRP drops allow. This silently costs time on every MPT loan repayment.
not_observed: No verbatim developer XRPL doc-questions this period; work was autonomous implementation, so doc gaps are inferred from failures, not quotes.

Public-Devnet comparison, closed-ended vault timing (SubscriptionDate/RedemptionDate min 180s), faucet payload differences, and the LoanBrokerCoverWithdraw and temBAD_SIGNER notes are hook reflection rows from parallel probe scripts; exact attempts and timings for those were not independently observed in the transcript.
Whether the LoanBrokerSet tecNO_PERMISSION divergence on rc5 is an intentional policy change or a regression was not determined.
Time-to-first-success per tx type is omitted rather than guessed: these are authored reference flows run once live, not iterative first-contact.
